response.rationale: The item is electronics with 8 days since delivery. The highest-priority applicable rule is RET-002 (electronics returnable within 15 days), which applies since days_since_delivery (8) <= 15, making the return eligible. Final-sale (RET-012) and defective (RET-020) rules do not apply because final_sale is False and defective is not True. Fraud hold and goodwill rules also do not apply.
